analyzed_vuln.description: The CIL binary builder permits libsepol type values larger than the 16-bit fields in avtab_key_t, and __cil_insert_avrule blindly assigns its 32-bit src/tgt arguments to uint16_t source_type/target_type. A type value of 65536 therefore becomes source_type 0. During neverallow checking, check_assertion_avtab_match treats the key as a valid one-based type value and indexes attr_type_map[k->source_type - 1]; the zero value produces an out-of-bounds ebitmap pointer, which is dereferenced by ebitmap_match_any at ebitmap.c:232. The insertion path must reject values that cannot be represented in avtab_key_t (and the builder should reject an excessive type/class count) rather than silently truncate them.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A CIL input must expand to at least 65,536 policy type/typeattribute values; the PoV achieves this through nested/repeated block inheritance despite having relatively little source text. It must then generate an allow/AV rule whose source type receives value 65536 (or another value truncating to zero in uint16_t), plus a relevant neverallow so cil_check_neverallows maps that malformed avtab entry. The harness parses the bytes as CIL, builds the policydb, inserts the truncated key in pass 3, and neverallow checking indexes the p_types.nprim-sized attr_type_map with source_type - 1, causing the heap-buffer-overflow read.

args: In selinux/libsepol/cil/src/cil_binary.c, where is the best point in cil_binary_create_allocated_pdb to reject p_types.nprim or p_classes.nprim greater than UINT16_MAX, and are both type and class values stored in uint16_t avtab_key_t fields? Please describe the builder pass ordering and existing analogous overflow checks.

The reported crash is caused by __cil_insert_avrule assigning uint32_t src/tgt/obj values into avtab_key_t's uint16_t source_type, target_type, and target_class fields. A generated type value 65536 truncates to zero and neverallow checking indexes attr_type_map[source_type - 1]. I intend to add a direct representability check in __cil_insert_avrule and an early aggregate type/class count check in the builder, while preserving valid policies up to UINT16_MAX. I have observed that cil_type_to_policydb and cil_typeattribute_to_policydb use symtab_insert to assign values, and pass 3 creates AV rules. I need the exact safest point after symbol population but before arrays/rules and any conventions in this code.
